reading.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team's listed product is vLLM, categorized under open source & self-hosted models, with high-throughput inference engine as the function this data names first.

The data also tags vLLM with open-source and no external data sharing, description of what the product does rather than how well it does it. It also notes self-hosted, one of the few entries in this set where the product touches compute or physical infrastructure directly rather than sitting purely at the application layer.

Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to github.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about UC Berkeley / vLLM Team's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is listed as a university lab and a non-profit organization, with github.com given as its website. The text harvested from that address describes GitHub itself, not the vLLM project: it presents GitHub as an AI-powered developer platform used by developers, businesses, and open source communities to build and ship software. That material does not describe the team or its work.

The product tracked for the team is vLLM, described as a high-throughput inference engine that is open source and self-hosted, with no external data sharing. It is listed under open source and self-hosted models, and its project page is at github.com/vllm-project/vllm.

No lawsuits and no MCP servers are listed for the team.
